elapsed_time.reason: determinism and source immutability are measured; wall-clock timing is intentionally not asserted by the offline demo

operation_family_descriptions.branch_worktree_ref_ops: Branch, worktree, checkout, ref, and history mutation commands are denied by the Git command wrapper.
operation_family_descriptions.filesystem_writes: AIDE report and fixture writes are allowed only under the AIDE repo; Dominium writes remain forbidden and are checked by before/after source hashes.
operation_family_descriptions.git_reads: Allowed read-only Git commands used to inspect an already-present Dominium repository.
operation_family_descriptions.mutation_apply: Patch/apply/preview/rollback behavior is outside the read-only seam and is refused.
operation_family_descriptions.network_attempts: Fetch, pull, clone, push, transport, and service verbs are unsupported by the seam and are represented only as refusal surfaces.
operation_family_descriptions.provider_model_attempts: Provider/model activity is not linked into the seam and remains an explicit non-capability.
operation_family_descriptions.worker_dispatch: Worker execution is not wired into the seam; subprocess use is limited to local Python CLI portability checks.
